title: Project Fantasy
description: New and expanded terrain, powerful gear, new and expanded dimensions
body:
# 🌍 Project Fantasy: Adventure, Magic & Engineering

A large, progression-focused Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge modpack that blends **exploration, new dimensions, magic systems, Create automation, tech storage, RPG combat, structures, and performance optimizations** into one cohesive survival experience.

This pack is designed for players who want **more to discover everywhere they go** — new biomes, dungeons, bosses, food, gear, mobs, and entire worlds — while still keeping Minecraft’s core survival gameplay intact.

---

## ✨ What to expect while playing this pack:

### 🗺 Exploration & World Generation

The Overworld, Nether, and End are heavily expanded with new terrain, biomes, and structures from mods like:

* Biomes O’ Plenty, Regions Unexplored, Terralith, Tectonic
* Repurposed Structures, Dungeons Arise, Dungeons Enhanced, Explorify, Structory
* Additional villages, ruins, temples, capitals, and underground locations

Expect more frequent discoveries, better loot, and reasons to travel far from spawn.

---

### 🌌 New Dimensions & Major Adventures

Multiple full dimensions and large adventure areas to progress through:

* The Aether (+ Deep Aether content)
* Blue Skies
* The Undergarden
* Outer End expansions
* Ad Astra space exploration (planets, rockets, technology)

Each dimension includes unique mobs, gear, and challenges.

---

### ⚙ Tech & Automation

Build factories, farms, and storage systems:

* Create (+ Addons)
* Applied Energistics 2
* Ender IO
* RFTools
* ComputerCraft

Automate resource production, power generation, crafting chains, and storage networks.

---

### 🔮 Magic & Fantasy Systems

Several magic paths with different playstyles:

* Ars Nouveau
* Blood Magic
* Occultism
* Iron’s Spells & Spellbooks
* RuneCraft and other mystical content

Focus on spells, rituals, summons, and magical automation.

---

### ⚔ Combat, Gear & RPG Content

More weapons, armor, and enemies:

* Epic Fight combat improvements
* Mowzie’s Mobs, Alex’s Mobs, Cataclysm bosses
* Simply Swords, Soulslike Weaponry, Immersive Armors, Artifacts, Relics
* New structures filled with tougher encounters and better loot

Lots of exploration-based combat.

---

## 🎯 Who is this for?

This pack is ideal if you enjoy:

* Long-term survival progression
* Exploration and dungeon crawling
* Automation and engineering
* Magic systems
* RPG-style combat and gear upgrades

---

## 🛠 Requirements

* Minecraft **1.20.1**
* **Forge 47.x**
* Recommended **6–8+ GB RAM**

---

## NOTE:
* The Modpack quest system is still a work in progress, if you have any suggestions please vist [here](https://discord.gg/PEXCw4n4TH)
